summary: Quiet Taringa street with parked cars; houses 12-20 m away on both sides.
reasons: Houses 12-14 m north, about 20 m south

best_section.where: Payne Street north kerb, just before the treed corner lot near the eastern cross street

drivers.seclusion: Dwellings within 25 m all round: north houses 12-14 m, south houses about 20 m.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb on a two-way residential street; cars park along both sides so room to pull in.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential street with a cross street at the east end.
drivers.convention: Cars are parked along the kerb here, so a van will not stand out much.

flags: Steep east of 175 m: about 15% fall to the corner
sun_shade: Mostly open; some street trees and house shade from the north side.
